blocks.text: Activity Diagrams kisi process mein activities ya steps ka bahao (flow) dikhate hain. Yeh complex kaamon ki logic (mantiq) ka model banane ke liye faidamand hain.

Misal: restaurant management system mein activity diagram 'Order Placement' (order dena) se 'Food Preparation' (khana tayyar karna) aur aakhir mein 'Order Delivery' (order pohanchana) tak ka process dikha sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Flowchart: Start (oval, anday jaisi shakal) se Order Placement, phir Food Preparation, phir heere ki shakal (diamond) wala sawal Food Ready?. Yes daen taraf Order Delivery tak; No baen taraf Re-Prepare Food tak, jahan se lakeer oopar Food Preparation mein wapas jati hai. Re-Prepare Food aur Order Delivery ki lakeerein ek chhote gol connector par milti hain, jahan se ek teer End tak jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.12: Decision aur connector nishan wala activity diagram (kitab ki Figure 1.12 ke mutabiq apni banayi hui drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Diamond decision (faisla) hai: khana tayyar hai to 'Yes' wala raasta Order Delivery ki taraf, nahi to 'No' wala raasta Re-Prepare Food ki taraf, aur wahan se khana dobara Food Preparation mein jata hai. Chhota gol nishan connector hai: do lakeerein yahan mil kar ek ho jati hain, aur us ek lakeer se process End par khatam hota hai. Kitab ki tasweer mein Re-Prepare Food ki neeche wali lakeer diamond ke andar se guzarti hai; yahan use diamond ke neeche se guzara gaya hai ta ke saaf nazar aaye.

Upar wala activity diagram dikhata hai ke process shuru se aakhir tak kaise chalta hai. Restaurant ki misal mein process 'Start' se shuru hota hai, 'Order Placement' par jata hai, phir 'Food Preparation' par, aur aakhir mein 'Order Delivery' par. 'End' node process khatam karta hai. Teer (arrows) steps ka order dikhate hain, is liye samajhna aasan hai ke order kaise aage barhta hai.

blocks.prompt: Sequence Diagram aur Activity Diagram ka muqabla karein aur aham farq bataein. (Short Question 7)
blocks.explanation: Sequence diagram dikhata hai ke kaun se objects ek doosre ko kaun se messages kis waqt ke order mein bhejte hain (lifelines aur teer). Activity diagram ek process ke steps aur faisle (decisions) Start se End tak dikhata hai (action boxes, decision diamond aur teer), lekin yeh nahi dikhata ke har step kaun sa object karta hai. Yani sequence diagram 'kaun kis se baat karta hai' par aur activity diagram 'kaam ka bahao' par zor deta hai.
